crons._comment: 07:00 UTC = 2:00 AM CDT / 1:00 AM CST. Sinclair's rebuilds their catalog between midnight and ~12:15 AM Central. This used to run at 05:05 UTC (12:05 AM CDT) — INSIDE that window — so the sweep sized the store mid-rebuild, got short department totals, locked them into the session and imported a fraction of the catalog before reporting itself done. Observed: store sized at 775 when Bakery alone reports 1,820. Do not move this earlier.
